tailoring.headline: Business Analyst / SAP Commerce Consultant | Requirements Engineering & Digital Products
tailoring.summary: Techno-functional Business Analyst and SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of experience bridging business stakeholders, product management and IT. Proven expertise in requirements engineering, user stories, process mapping, gap analysis, and data integration across enterprise digital products and e-commerce platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell. Skilled in facilitating workshops, coordinating international teams, and leveraging agile methodologies and Jira/Confluence to translate complex requirements into scalable technical solutions.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Business Analyst (m/w/d) Digital Products & Apps
cover_en.hook: GENO Broker’s mission to develop a new digital brokerage platform backed by the Genossenschaftliche FinanzGruppe presents an exciting environment for rigorous business analysis. With over 5 years of enterprise experience bridging business domains, product management, and technical delivery at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in translating complex requirements into robust digital solutions.

bullets.label: Requirements Engineering & User Stories
bullets.text: Extensively elicited, analysed, and structured functional requirements, authoring precise user stories and functional specifications to translate complex business needs into clear, actionable technical implementations.

bullets.label: Process Analysis & Optimization
bullets.text: Mapped and analysed intricate business processes, identifying optimization potentials and designing robust solutions and data flows across enterprise systems.

bullets.label: Stakeholder Facilitation
bullets.text: Planned and moderated workshops with business stakeholders, product management, and international technical teams to align requirements, manage dependencies, and ensure transparent communication.

bullets.label: Agile Digital Delivery
bullets.text: Operated within Agile and Scrum frameworks using Jira and Confluence to coordinate cross-functional alignment, manage backlogs, and drive the successful delivery of complex digital applications.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit requiring no sponsorship, I am serving a notice period ending 15 December 2026, with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my analytical approach can support GENO Broker's new digital offerings.

tailoring.why_company: GENO Broker's development of a new digital brokerage offering with the backing of the Genossenschaftliche FinanzGruppe combines strong institutional roots with agile product innovation. I am eager to apply my techno-functional expertise in requirements engineering and digital product delivery to help bridge business needs and IT execution in this exciting growth phase.
tailoring.motivation_short: I am driven by the challenge of translating complex business requirements into clear, functional digital products through structured analysis and cross-functional collaboration.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello! I am a Business Analyst and SAP Commerce professional with 5+ years of enterprise experience in requirements engineering, process mapping, and agile digital delivery. GENO Broker's new digital products initiative aligns perfectly with my background. I would love to connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application: Business Analyst (m/w/d) Digital Products & Apps – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Business Analyst position for Digital Products & Apps at GENO Broker.

With over 5 years of experience in requirements analysis, user story creation, process mapping, and cross-functional stakeholder management within enterprise digital platforms, I am well-prepared to contribute effectively to your team.

I am based in Karlsruhe with a valid work permit and am available starting 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing my application with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
